item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_armor.desc: Two pieces halve fall damage; four wrap you in the storm. Sturdier in the air, and jumping again mid-air dashes you forward (rests 8 seconds)
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_bow.desc: Its arrows hit hard. Struck foes glow, and a small bolt leaps to another foe nearby
item.skyabyss.storm_anklet.desc: While in a trinket slot, gliding is faster and falls hurt less
item.skyabyss.storm_charm.desc: When used, your next three attacks call down lightning (rests 30 seconds)
item.skyabyss.raiju_claw.desc: Three quick claws. Every third strike, lightning leaps to another foe nearby
item.skyabyss.warden_glaive.desc: Long reach. Bites deep into airborne foes, or when you strike while falling
item.skyabyss.storm_eye_feather.desc: While in a trinket slot, the wind turns aside arrows and shots flying at you (rests 3 seconds)
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_shard.desc: A sliver of a Thunder Wing quill. Used to enhance Thunder Wing gear at the Resonance Forge
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_core.desc: A fragment of lightning from the Thunder Wing's heart. Someday, material for an artifact
item.skyabyss.cloudgap_fruit.desc: Fruit dried in a gap of the clouds. For 30 seconds after eating, you hold no static (moth discharges will not leap to you)
item.skyabyss.moth_dust.desc: Powder from a static moth's wing. Craft it with arrows to make spectral arrows
message.skyabyss.storm_charm.armed: Lightning coils around your arm (%s left)
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_no_clear.thu: Defeat the Thunder Wing heart to choose
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_all_owned.th: You hold every Thunder Wing exclusive
